concepts.label: ep-engine background task class
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted earlier in this batch on cbstats-runtimes.json; reused here since compactor_tasks, statsnap_tasks, checkpoint_remover_tasks, flusher_tasks etc. are the same class of internally-scheduled job named with a `_tasks` suffix

relations.subject: monitoring:ep-engine-background-task
relations.evidence: This command provides scheduler task statistics.

notable_absence.finding: This page's own histogram-total counts reveal an internal-scheduler mechanism this ontology has never had occasion to name: a per-task-class SCHEDULING QUEUE whose backlog can be enormous and highly skewed - checkpoint_remover_tasks shows 499385125 total runs and flusher_tasks 623149835, versus vbucket_persist_high_tasks' 4, all reported through the same per-task-class histogram. No concept anywhere in the registry represents 'a named ep-engine scheduler queue/task-class, sampled by histogram of run-time distribution' as a first-class mechanism distinct from the task itself; this page is purely that mechanism and nothing else, which is why it is the single clearest example in this batch of the round's predicted near-zero vocabulary overlap. A future round revisiting Data Service internals more broadly (e.g. a memcached/ep-engine architecture overview page, if one exists) should check whether a dedicated 'scheduler queue' or 'task priority class' concept belongs in the registry rather than being represented only as evidence text here.

cross_component_finding: The `_tasks` suffix names here (compactor_tasks, statsnap_tasks, conn_notification_tasks, access_scanner_tasks, warmup_tasks, vbucket_persist_low_tasks, hashtable_resize_tasks, workload_monitor_tasks, checkpoint_remover_tasks, flusher_tasks, vbucket_persist_high_tasks, bg_fetcher_tasks, conn_manager_tasks, item_pager_tasks) are the same task-class vocabulary that appears, spelled as CamelCase class names rather than snake_case histogram keys, in cbstats-runtimes.md (e.g. ClosedUnrefCheckpointRemoverVisitorTask for checkpoint_remover_tasks) and cbstats-tasks.md's Name column - three cbstats subcommands describing what is evidently the same underlying set of internal task classes through three different naming conventions, with no page reconciling them.
cross_product_finding: None - this page is Couchbase Server CLI-only with no Capella-facing surface.
